node.title: I want to know the current week number of the current month
node.author: Muskovitz
node.doctext:
Hello monks!

#!C:\xampp\perl\bin\perl.exe use strict; use warnings; use Date::Calc qw/Week_Number/; use POSIX qw/strftime/; my($yy,$mm,$dd)=Today(); my $DATE=strftime "%b %Y", localtime(); my $WEEKNUM=Week_Number($yy, $mm, $dd); print "It is Week: $WEEKNUM As of $DATE
"; I am expecting the result would be It is Week: 2 As of Oct 2017 but instead i get It is Week: 41 As of Oct 2017

I want to get the week number of the current month so i can know if it is 2nd week of october or 3rd and so on ...
